title: Step by step Dance TUTORIAL for Ankhiyon Se Goli Mare song | Shipra's Dance Class

method.teacher_system: The teacher breaks down the dance into small, manageable chunks, demonstrating each step clearly. She then combines these chunks into a sequence, repeating them to ensure the learner understands the flow. Finally, she integrates the music, guiding the learner through the full routine at a comfortable pace.
method.signature: The teacher uses a split-screen view to show both the full-body performance and a close-up of the feet, which is very helpful for learning complex footwork.

practices.what: The teacher breaks down the initial gun-shot move, explaining the foot and hand positions step-by-step.
The teacher repeats the 'baby meri hai' sequence multiple times to help the learner memorize the steps.
The teacher adds hip movements to the existing footwork, layering the styling on top of the basic steps.
The teacher practices the sequence at a slower pace before speeding it up to match the music.
The teacher highlights the common mistake of not shifting weight correctly and shows the proper technique.
The teacher provides a final recap of the steps, preparing the learner for the next section of the dance.

adaptations.difficulty: Folding the little and ring fingers while keeping the thumb and index finger extended.
adaptations.adjustment: The teacher demonstrates the hand position clearly and encourages the learner to practice it until it feels natural.

adaptations.difficulty: Moving the feet while bending the knees.
adaptations.adjustment: The teacher advises the learner to focus only on bending the knees and keeping the feet still.

adaptations.difficulty: Bending the knees while moving the hips.
adaptations.adjustment: The teacher suggests focusing only on the eye movements and keeping the body still.

adaptations.difficulty: Maintaining balance on one leg while throwing the other.
adaptations.adjustment: The teacher emphasizes the importance of shifting the full body weight onto the standing leg.

adaptations.difficulty: Coordinating facial expressions with the hand movements.
adaptations.adjustment: The teacher advises the learner to keep the mouth slightly open and move the eyebrows up and down.

beliefs.belief: The teacher believes that breaking down complex dance moves into smaller, simpler parts is the most effective way to learn.
Dancing is a shared activity that can be enjoyed with friends and family.

feelings.response: The teacher acknowledges that facial expressions can feel unnatural at first and encourages the learner to keep practicing.

moments.says: The teacher introduces the song and encourages the learner to share the video with friends and cousins to dance together.
The teacher breaks down the foot and hand positions for the opening move, explaining the specific finger and toe placement.
The teacher explains that the next sequence requires quick movements and demonstrates the rhythm of the steps.
The teacher emphasizes the importance of facial expressions, specifically instructing the learner to open their mouth and move their eyebrows.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable and prepared to perform the dance by providing clear, step-by-step instructions.

clicked.theme: The teacher's clear and easy-to-follow explanations

requests.theme: Requests for tutorials on specific songs

meant.theme: Gratitude and appreciation for the teacher's effort

method.limits: The video only covers the first 600 seconds of the dance, so I cannot provide information about the entire routine.
